item.title: Hoosier Riverwatch Stream Survey: Trevlac 4 — Wed Oct 14, 8:30 AM — Trevlac Bluffs Nature Preserve
item.description:
Join Sycamore Land Trust and the Indiana Geological and Water Survey to help monitor the health of local streams through Hoosier Riverwatch at Trevlac Bluffs Nature Preserve. Volunteers will wade into the stream to collect and identify aquatic macroinvertebrates and conduct chemical water quality tests, helping track seasonal changes in stream health at two protected properties along Beanblossom Creek. We’ll discuss how geology, land use, and forest cover influence water conditions. All monitoring supplies are provided through a grant from IDEM, and no prior experience is required. Participants should be comfortable standing and walking in shallow water. Join us to learn more about Hoosier Riverwatch and contribute valuable data that supports Indiana’s waterways.
Source: Sycamore Land Trust

item.title: Hike the Trust: Porter West Preserve — Sun Oct 18, 9:00 AM — Porter West Preserve
item.description:
Join Sycamore Land Trust for our Hike the Trust hike at Porter West Preserve! As we trek the 2.5 mile upland loop, we’ll see how this landscape continues to evolve: shaped by past storms, shifting plant communities, and the steady processes of forest succession. We’ll take time to botanize, and keep our eyes and ears open for fall migrant birds moving through the preserve. We’ll explore how long-term protection and stewardship help ensure places like this continue to thrive.
Source: Sycamore Land Trust

item.title: Oaks in the Fall with CanopyBloomington — Fri Oct 23, 5:00 PM — Amy Weingartner Branigin Peninsula Preserve
item.description:
Feel the breeze and botanize with Sycamore Land Trust and CanopyBloomington during Oaks in the Fall at Amy Weingartner Branigin Peninsula Preserve! We’ll focus on oak identification, learning how to recognize different species by their leaves, bark, and habitat while discussing their role as keystone species that support countless birds, insects, and wildlife. CanopyBloomington’s work to grow and care for Bloomington’s urban forest pairs perfectly with Sycamore’s efforts to protect and restore natural areas across the region, highlighting how urban and wild forests function as one connected, thriving system!
Source: Sycamore Land Trust
